summary: Creates a MAT output connector on a Component so internal material networks can expose a named material result to the parent network.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Popup label shown for this Component MAT output

key_params.name: dodeform
key_params.note: Enable deform handling on the output material

key_concepts: Out MAT creates a material output connector on the right side of a Component so internal MAT networks can expose a named result.
Component MAT outputs are positioned alphanumerically, making output node names part of the reusable component API.
The Label parameter documents the output connector for parent-network users.
Out MAT can carry deform and common render-state behavior, so it should be treated as the intentional final material wrapper.
A Null MAT before Out MAT gives component authors a stable internal endpoint when the material network may be refactored.
common_gotchas: Component MAT outputs are positioned alphanumerically, so use stable names for reusable component APIs.
Out MAT should be the intentional endpoint for a component's material output, not an incidental internal material.
Common MAT render-state pages still apply if edited on the Out MAT.
Expose a Null MAT before Out MAT when the internal material network may be refactored.
